info.title: Research completed windows and native execution API
info.description: All-time descriptive analytics; WFO training folds remain separate and have no independent Holdout. Native source relation ordinals are not a global causal ordering. Null fields have explicit source absence; no inferred SL/TP/OCO or broker events.

WindowObservation.description: Public read projection only. active_stop and active_take_profit are null when flat or without a positive source level. active_level_availability records each typed reason and the original exact source_value. revision remains the immutable retained-source identity, not a hash of this normalized DTO. No normalization of journal/order-intent prices.
